text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: When I ask about her goals, Tosen Jordan vaguely answers that she wants to "make it big."

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: But just before her debut race, her usual laid-back demeanor suddenly changes. She tenses up, wondering if she might not be good enough.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I figure she might feel more comfortable talking to her friends, so I leave it to Mejiro Palmer to offer her support.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Tosen Jordan's fears slowly melt away. When I see her again, she looks full of determination.
